text.p: Dresser Industries Inc said Thursday it and Shaw Industries Ltd are extending their joint venture, Dresser-Shaw Co, through the year 2030.

As consideration Shaw will pay Dresser $41.7 million over a four year period plus interest, for a total of $50 million, Dresser said. It will reflect the payment with an after-tax gain of $27.1 million, or $0.15 per share, in the fourth quarter ending October 30.
The venture, an alliance of Dresser's Bredero Price unit and Shaw Pipe Protection, supplies corrosion and concrete coatings to pipeline markets worldwide.
Dresser said the extension, which has been approved by directors of both companies, will be subject to the approval of U.S. regulatory authorities.
Under the new agreement, the 1996 joint venture agreement provides for early termination after two years. Each party will have equal ownership, control and entitlement to worldwide earnings.
